source: Client CSV 2026-10-14 (segmentation by product/technology, service/business model, application, end user, geography); cap 120, one browser per market, INDIA ONLY (owner 2026-10-14), state by state
market_definition: The India Digital Twin Market - Infrastructure, Utilities & Smart Cities covers companies providing the following. Products and technology: Twin type: asset twin, network twin, city twin; enabling technology: IoT, AI/ML, BIM, GIS, drone/LiDAR, cloud, edge computing; visualization: 2D/3D dashboards, BIM viewer, 3D city model. Services and business models: Twin-platform subscription, reality-capture service, BIM-to-twin integration, IoT integration, simulation and scenario modeling, managed digital-twin operations. Applications: Design and construction, operations and maintenance, predictive maintenance, asset performance, safety, sustainability, urban planning, remote monitoring. End users: Construction, real estate, utilities, telecom, transportation, manufacturing, government/smart cities, energy and utilities. Geography: India -- companies HEADQUARTERED IN India (a foreign company's Indian office, branch or distributor does not qualify).
core_scope: A core player itself provides digital-twin solutions for infrastructure, utilities and smart cities under its own name: asset, network or city twin platforms, BIM-to-twin and GIS / IoT integration, reality-capture (drone / LiDAR / 3D city model) services, simulation and scenario modelling, and managed digital-twin operations for construction, utilities, transport, telecom and government.
adjacent_segments: Manufacturing-only or product digital-twin vendors with no infrastructure, utility or city twin
General IoT or cloud platforms with no digital-twin product
General IT services firms with no digital-twin practice
scope: ONLY companies HEADQUARTERED IN India. ONLY companies that operate in this market under their own name. A core player itself provides digital-twin solutions for infrastructure, utilities and smart cities under its own name: asset, network or city twin platforms, BIM-to-twin and GIS / IoT integration, reality-capture (drone / LiDAR / 3D city model) services, simulation and scenario modelling, and managed digital-twin operations for construction, utilities, transport, telecom and government. NOT core: Manufacturing-only or product digital-twin vendors with no infrastructure, utility or city twin; General IoT or cloud platforms with no digital-twin product; General IT services firms with no digital-twin practice; BIM / CAD resellers.
